findings.title: slice(1, limit + 1) drops the newest invoice and returns the wrong page
findings.explanation: The extra row fetched to detect another page is the last one, at index `limit`. The page should be `rows.slice(0, limit)`. Starting at index 1 drops the first and newest invoice on every page, so clients never see it. It also returns only `limit - 1` rows when the page is not full. For example, with 1 invoice and limit 25, `page` is empty. With limit=1 and 1 row, `page` is empty. Change it to `rows.slice(0, limit)`.

findings.title: page[page.length - 1] can throw when the page is empty
findings.explanation: With the off-by-one slice, `page` can be empty while `hasMore` is true. This happens with limit=1 and 2 rows, where the slice gives 1 element. If the slice is wrong in other ways, `page[page.length - 1]` is undefined and `.id` throws a TypeError, which becomes a 500. This goes away once the slice is `slice(0, limit)`, because `hasMore` then implies `page.length === limit >= 1`.

findings.title: No tests for the pagination boundary cases
findings.explanation: The bug above would have been caught by a simple test. Add tests for: fewer than limit rows, exactly limit rows (next_before is null), limit + 1 rows (next_before is the last returned id), no rows, and following next_before across pages to check that no invoice is skipped or duplicated.

findings.title: Missing error handling for async handler and zod parse
findings.explanation: `listSchema.parse` and `pool.query` can throw inside an async handler. Depending on the Express version, this may result in unhandled rejections instead of a 400 or 500 response. This is not new in this PR, but a `safeParse` returning 400 would be better.

Review this pull request.

## Fix next_before when the last page is exactly full

When the last page had exactly `limit` invoices, `next_before` was still set, so the web app made one extra request that came back empty. This fetches `limit + 1` rows to know whether another page exists.

## Diff

```diff
diff --git a/src/routes/invoices.ts b/src/routes/invoices.ts
index b9edb19..8e99e4e 100644
--- a/src/routes/invoices.ts
+++ b/src/routes/invoices.ts
@@ -19,11 +19,13 @@ invoicesRouter.get('/', async (req, res) => {
       WHERE org_id = $1 AND ($2::bigint IS NULL OR id < $2)
       ORDER BY id DESC
       LIMIT $3`,
-    [req.user.orgId, before ?? null, limit],
+    [req.user.orgId, before ?? null, limit + 1],
   )
+  const hasMore = rows.length > limit
+  const page = rows.slice(1, limit + 1)
   res.json({
-    invoices: rows.map(serializeInvoice),
-    next_before: rows.length === limit ? rows[rows.length - 1].id : null,
+    invoices: page.map(serializeInvoice),
+    next_before: hasMore ? page[page.length - 1].id : null,
   })
 })
```
